Kill [[Destor the Truth Seeker]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Destor the Truth Seeker]] in [[Kessex Peak (War in Kryta)|Kessex Peak]]
* *BONUS* Kill Destor the Truth Seeker in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 10 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 5 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
The [[Temple of the Ages]] is the only outpost in Kryta that lets you form a party of eight, so you should start from there. Travel through [[The Black Curtain (War in Kryta)|The Black Curtain]] to Kessex Peak, killing various creatures and [[White Mantle]]/[[Peacekeeper]]s along the way. In Kessex Peak, follow the trail south-southwest and you will eventually run into Destor. Kill him and then claim your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''""Truth Seeker" is the ironic sobriquet of Destor, a close-minded, brutal sadist who unquestioningly follows the cruel edicts of the [[Unseen Ones]]. For the violence and terror Destor has inflicted in the name of his invisible masters, the Queen has placed a bounty on his head. Those allies of Kryta who slay this monstrous zealot will receive a royal bounty and the hearty thanks of the Krytan nation."''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Relive this classic quest from the War in Kryta! "Truth Seeker" was the ironic sobriquet of Destor, a close-minded, brutal sadist who unquestioningly followed the cruel edicts of the Unseen Ones. For the violence and terror Destor inflicted in the name of his invisible masters, foreign adventures tracked the villain down and disposed of him during the war. Re-create the hunt for this monstrous zealot and receive a royal bounty by slaying Destor."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll do whatever I can to help restore order to Kryta.
| decline = War! What is it good for?
| ask = Free the good people of Kessex Peak from the menace of Destor the Truth Seeker.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Princess Salma
:''"Thank you <Character name>, your efforts bring us one step closer to a unified nation."''

==Notes==
* It is efficient to do this quest with [[Wanted: Justiciar Amilyn]] and [[Wanted: Justiciar Marron]] for a total of 45 supplies in Hard Mode. These bosses are close to each other and their bounties are relatively close in the quest cycle. You still need to accept each quest on the day it's available.
